summary: @ornikar/eslint-config-node preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes bundled 727KB obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is identifier-obfuscated (_0x... names) and, at `npm install` time, downloads the Bun runtime zip from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts the `bun` binary to a temp directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against the shipped `math_init.js` file via `execFileSync(bunPath, [path.join(D, 'math_init.js')], { stdio: 'inherit' })`. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB single-line file with rotated string-array obfuscation (`WV8StW` shift routine), a large numeric constant table, and a `@bun` bytecode marker; it is not referenced by index.js and exposes no ESLint-related functionality. An eslint-config package has no legitimate need to fetch an alternate JavaScript runtime and use it to execute an opaque bundled sibling during preinstall. Executing an obfuscated payload under a freshly downloaded alternate runtime evades static scanners restricted to Node-resolved code and runs with the installer's user privileges.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
